thread:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: routing.policy.error spike detected - sudden increase in routed traffic to dedicated-pool-2 for tenant prod-42. Error rate 18% > threshold 5%. Samples show model variant mismatch (gptx-quant-v2) returning OOM/invalid-kv errors. root thread_ts=1718209999
Lina (on-call): paging @channel -- I'm taking this. seeing the same in console, high 5xx and connection resets.
Jordan SRE: on it. initial guess: policy fallback kicked in and routed hosted traffic into dedicated because capacity-tier tag didn't match.
Maya - Eng Runtime: Confirmed: smart-routing evaluated candidate pools, matched by model compatibility but ignored tenant_isolation flag due to a race in policy-eval cache.
Raj - Platform: Can we flip the emergency routing guard to block dedicated pool ingestion from hosted tier?
Lina (on-call): Yes. doing a scoped policy toggle now. Running:
```bash
redwoodctl routing update --selector \"pool:dEDICATED && !tenant:prod-42\" --set disabled=true --dry-run=false
```
Lina (on-call): applied. pushing small guard patch to control plane to reject cross-tier bind.
Sam - Eng-ML: logs show model variant mismatch requests were for \"gptx-quant-v2\" but dedicated pool only supports \"gptx-quant-v1\" (KV layout diff). That's why we saw invalid-kv and deserialization failures.
Alex - CS: Heads-up: prod-42 has several customers on Dedicated+Hosted fallback. I'm drafting a customer-facing note; need impact window estimate.
Jordan SRE: Traffic to dedicated-pool-2 dropped ~92% after guard; errors down to 1.2%. Monitoring for regression.
Maya - Eng Runtime: Pinned model variant mapping and pushed an immediate policy hotfix to prefer tenant_isolation high priority. Patch gist:
```yaml
policy: smart-routing
match_priority: [tenant_isolation, model_family, region, cost_tier]
cache_ttl_seconds: 5  # reduced from 60 during incident window
```
Maya - Eng Runtime: Also invalidating policy-eval cache for affected clusters.
Lina (on-call): Confirmed no further OOMs in dedicated pool. Starting controlled reroute tests to ensure hosted fallback no longer spills.
Sam - Eng-ML: Test load looks good. Model variant compatibility check added to pre-route validation.
Raj - Platform: Rolling an emergency feature-flag to enforce strict pool namespace isolation across routing decisions. Command:
```json
{"op": "set", "key": "routing.strict_pool_isolation", "value": true}
```
Raj - Platform: Flag rolled in region-us-west-2 only for now.
Alex - CS: Impact update for customers: some requests were routed to Dedicated pool and returned errors for ~12 minutes (1718209999 - 1718210719). Affected: subset of tenants with fallback enabled; approx 0.6% of total hosted traffic. Preparing an incident advisory.
Jordan SRE: Paging handoff: Lina, I'll be handing this to you for post-incident follow-up. I need to return to another pager.
Lina (on-call): Ack. Jordan - thank you. I'll own the postmortem and follow-ups.
Maya - Eng Runtime: Preliminary root cause: race in policy-eval cache invalidation when updating model catalog + TTL mismatch allowed stale priority ordering. Secondary contributor: fallback policy allowed pool match by model_family before tenant isolation check.
Sam - Eng-ML: Mitigations applied: 1) guard to block hosted->dedicated binds, 2) lowered cache TTL, 3) pre-route model-variant compatibility check.
Lina (on-call): Customer impact classification: P2 — degraded for small set of tenants, errors but not data loss. Filing P2 incident.
Alex - CS: I'll send a targeted message to affected customers in the next 30m with root cause summary and mitigation steps.
Raj - Platform: Opening a follow-up ticket to add unit tests for policy evaluation ordering and to add e2e against tenant_isolation semantics. Ticket: PLAT-3748.
Jordan SRE: Can we add an automated canary that injects a fake hosted request and verifies no routing into dedicated pools?
Maya - Eng Runtime: Yes. Adding a synthetic check into the routing health probe. Details in the runtime repo.
Lina (on-call): Logged timeline and mitigation commands to the incident doc: https://console.internal/incidents/1718209999 (will update).
Alex - CS: Noting legal/reg compliance: no customer keys accessed, no lat/loss of persisted user data.
Sam - Eng-ML: Proposing longer-term fixes: align model variant naming, add compatibility matrix to catalog, and fail-fast on KV schema mismatch.
Lina (on-call): Handoff to oncall follow-up: I'll triage the PLAT ticket, coordinate postmortem, and drive customer comms. If anyone has additional logs or traces, drop them here.
Maya - Eng Runtime: Posting sample logs and stack traces to the incident doc.
IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: RESOLVE: routing.policy.error spike resolved and mitigations applied. Closing alert.
Lina (on-call): Closing thread for live mitigation. We'll reconvene in the postmortem channel with a timeline and action items. :thumbsup:
